name: Caltrops (Bag)
desc: As a Utilize action, you can spread them to cover a 5-foot square within 5 feet. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Collecting the caltrops takes 10 minutes.
